text:
Maya Chen: hey! first day question — who do I bug about laptop provisioning / VPN and desk setup? I have approval id 42-PR-2024-88 but no laptop yet. Also need a monitor arm. @jamal

Jamal R.: welcome Maya! :wave: For monitor/desk stuff, @ops-requests channel is the fastest. For laptop/VPN provisioning, ping infra. DM me the approval id and I'll check the queue.

ops-bot: New ticket created: OPS-4521 for Maya Chen — monitor arm request. ETA: 3–5 business days.

Kevin (IT): Maya — I pulled your request, it looks pending. Do you have an order/asset tag in the approval email? If not, paste the approval id here and I'll escalate.

Maya Chen: thanks! approval id is 42-PR-2024-88. no asset tag in the email.

Sahil (infra): Kicked the provisioning job. Sometimes Okta invites take a bit. You should get an Okta invite email in ~15–30m. Meanwhile, try running `ssh -T git@github.com` to check SSH access.

Maya Chen: ran it — got: Permission denied (publickey)

Sahil (infra): Means your SSH key isn't on GitHub yet. Follow the pinned doc in #devex (ssh-setup), or paste your public key here and I can temporarily add it. Also check spam for Okta.

Dev Ex Bot: Pinned doc: https://redwood.dev/docs/ssh-setup — start with `ssh-keygen -t ed25519` and then add the pubkey to GitHub.

Maya Chen: uploading key now. thanks everyone! quick Q: is there a preferred channel to ask about desk plants and parking? :seedling:

People Ops: For plants/parking, use #random for informal stuff or Facilities in #people-ops for formal requests. Heads up: avoid strong scents in shared desks.

Jamal R.: :thumbsup: Also, if you need hardware swaps later, use the 'hardware' form in the Console (Console > Support > Hardware request).
